scope: Static pre-execution review of one signed-semivariance risk-information plan, prior closed card descriptions and source code, primary research papers, official Qlib documentation, and XNYS calendar metadata. No actual Qlib price/feature arrays, prior or new Recorder objects, model fits, bootstrap draws, or portfolio accounts were read or run.

novelty_decision.reason: The closed minute allocator used a full-session five-minute downside share among many neural H5 allocation features. The closed risk OOF card tested unsigned intraday RV against a 09:47-to-next-09:47 squared-return target. The new nested question is whether the signed composition q of prior full-session one-minute RV adds information for next full-RTH RV after controlling for RV1, RV5, RV22 and signed RTH return. Changing the bar size or factor name alone would not justify another experiment; the distinct conditional target and comparison do.
novelty_decision.limits: The Patton-Sheppard signed-semivariance mechanism motivates the direction, but neither cited paper establishes this SOXX result, a tradable volatility signal, or fee-net SOXX outperformance. Closed allocator and risk routes stay closed.

calendar_metadata_verification.method: Independently recomputed only the versioned exchange_calendars XNYS schedule and canonical ET open/close/minute serialization in the local qlib_venv; no Qlib numeric source was queried.
calendar_metadata_verification.pre_read_requirement: A durable exact version/source/calendar seal must be written before any numeric D.features call, and the same bounded seal checked at held-phase entry. Do not use an unbounded future calendar as a held-year filter.

approved_fixed_contract: Read only pinned SOXX raw-NONE 1-minute Qlib source fields via qlib.init, D.calendar, bounded D.features, phase DatasetH, and a new R Recorder. A full regular or official early-close RTH session must have every expected right-edge bar and valid positive prices; no missing-bar or overnight bridging.

For each completed session, compute 1-minute RV, negative semivariance share q, signed RTH return, and consecutive native-session RV1/RV5/RV22. Target the following full RTH RV. Features are prior-close information for a 09:29 ET forecast; target maturity follows that next official close.

Fit only one baseline OLS and one q-augmented OLS on identical eligible 2019-2022 target rows, with at least 200 rows and full rank. Freeze both coefficient sets and training-only smearing factors before any 2023+ numeric price or label read.

For the 2023-01-03 to 2026-10-09 held target sessions, any missing target or required prior 22-session predictor member aborts the information screen as needs_data. Never compress gapped valid rows into adjacent 63-session bootstrap positions.

On fully contiguous held sessions, use paired QLIKE_B minus QLIKE_C, one stationary bootstrap with 10000 resamples, mean circular block 63 sessions, seed 20261014 and one-sided lower quantile .025/15. Pass requires positive fitted q coefficient, positive held paired mean, and positive lower bound; no sign, window, seed or model search.

A passing risk-information result permits only a separately frozen economic study with actual SOXL/SOXX/cash portfolios, matching SOXX opportunity cost, fees, slippage, risk, annual/rolling stability and independent forward evidence. It gives no account, allocation, or promotion permission by itself.
execution_boundary: This accepts a pre-data scientific design, not a research result. If any pinned byte, XNYS/Qlib calendar, session coverage, maturity, rank, or source version requirement fails, report needs_data or the precise execution failure without tuning this fixed candidate. A negative information result closes this version while the continuous fee-net SOXX objective remains active.
